title: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 -Walk-in-Interview for Research Associate III Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Research Associate III position. Candidates who have qualified in MD/ MS, MDS, M.Pharm, M.V.Sc., M.E/ M.Tech, Ph.D can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates ...
